focus_areas: Specular highlight consistency on curved metal
Mechanical plausibility of rivets and joints
Edge sharpness of the armholes and neck opening
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'rivets'. In AI-generated armor, rivets often look like painted dots rather than 3D objects casting micro-shadows. Also, check if the reflection logic holds up across the complex curves of the breastplate.
image_description: A close-up view of a dark, metallic breastplate (part of a suit of armor) against a plain off-white background. The armor features a glossy, reflective black or dark grey finish with visible rivets and overlapping plate segments (lames) near the bottom. A leather strap is visible at the top left, suggesting suspension. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the curved metal surfaces.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a breastplate/aegis and not a generic helmet or shield part.
To verify the structural integrity of the plate edges and rivets, ensuring they don't bleed into the background or each other.
To analyze the realism of the specular highlights and metal texture, checking for AI-style 'smearing' in reflections.

evidence.thinking_trajectory: The image appears to be clear and well-lit, but there are no visible signs of noise, blur, or darkening. The image seems to have a slight compression, as indicated by the minor pixelation on the edges, but this is not significant enough to be considered a distortion. The image is clear and the object is easily identifiable.
